site.title: Force Lab

stage.tipPan: Drag to move the camera. Scroll or pinch to zoom.

controls.title: Force controls
controls.subtitle: Choose a direction and strength

lesson.text: A force is a push or pull. Forces can speed things up, slow them down, or change their direction.
science.title: Science challenge
science.text: Can you make the box stay still? Try adding the same force in opposite directions.
